cards.answer: First Affiliated Hospital of Anhui Medical University
cards.quote: In the bustling city of Hefei, China, a beacon of hope shines bright in the form of the First Affiliated Hospital of Anhui Medical University. This esteemed institution has been at the forefront of medical innovation, providing top-notch care to the people of Anhui Province and beyond. Among the hospital's esteemed researchers, one name stands out for their unwavering dedication and groundbreaking contributions: Xiao-Jin He. As we delve into the remarkable story of Xiao-Jin He, it becomes evident that their association with the First Affiliated Hospital of Anhui Medical University is more than just a mere affiliation – it's a testament to their unrelenting pursuit of medical excellence. The year was 2005 when Xiao-Jin He first joined the hospital's research team.
